# Emergency fund plan

Target is six months of essential expenses sitting somewhere boring and immediately reachable, not
invested in anything that could be down 20% the week it's actually needed.

## Where it lives

Sitting in a high-yield savings account, separate from the checking account it would eventually get
transferred into, specifically so it doesn't blend into the everyday spending balance and get eroded
a little at a time without ever being a deliberate decision.

## Current progress

About four and a half months of coverage saved so far, on track to hit the six-month target by early
next year at the current contribution rate. Freelance income variability is exactly why this number
matters more than it would with a steady paycheck — a slow month can't turn into a crisis if there's
a buffer absorbing it.

## Rule

Once the fund is topped up to the target, extra savings redirect to the brokerage account instead —
see [[brokerage-notes]] — rather than letting the emergency fund grow past what it's actually for.
